newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-Hair dye maker Carson a hit.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-Hair dye maker Carson a hit.

text.p: Carson Inc shares jumped after the company's initial public offering on Tuesday as investors snapped up shares of the company, which makes hair color and other hair care products for African-Americans.
Carson was one of the most heavily traded stocks on the New York Stock Exchange, with over a million shares changing hands in the first hour of trading.
Carson rose 1-1/2 to 15-1/2. The shares priced at $14, at the bottom of their estimated pricing range of $14 to $16.
Of the total 4.19 million shares to be offered, 2.48 million were offered by the Savannah, Georgia-based company and the rest were offered by selling shareholders, according to the prospectus.
Carson's fiscal 1996 sales grew 17.5 percent to $68.3 million from $58.1 million. Its 1996 operating income grew to $12.0 million from $8.2 million in 1995.
